text:
incident-bot: ALERT — Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts detected for customer LuminaShop on Dedicated cluster d-cluster-8 (us-west1). 5xx rate: 18% (5m), error spike started ~10:08 UTC. Auto-threshold tripped for latency & error-rate.

olivia: ack — paging oncall (raj) and CS. I'm handing off — was awake fyi, saw initial surge around 10:05.

raj: taking it. thanks olivia. first things: scope impact and whether it's noisy-tenant vs infra. maria (CS) can you confirm customer-facing symptoms?

maria (CS): LuminaShop reports API errors from their production stack since ~10:04. They see 502/504 on generation endpoints and some streams drop. Reported rate ~15-20% from their side. They asked for ETA.

raj: understood. mike, can you pull cluster metrics (gpu/queue/kv) and any pod restarts?

mike: running quick checks — past 15m: GPU util across pool normal, but inference-worker pods on node-gpu-23 show high rps and high runtime queues. Posting outputs:

```kubectl -n dedicated get pods -o wide | egrep "inference|worker"
inference-worker-23-abcde   3/3 Running   0     6h   10.1.23.45   node-gpu-23
inference-worker-45-fghij   1/3 CrashLoopBackOff   4     11m  10.1.24.11   node-gpu-19

# GPU metrics (short):
node-gpu-23 gpu_util 94%  mem_used 78%  queue_len 120
node-gpu-19 gpu_util 20%  mem_used 12%   queue_len 2
```

sara: looks like a very hot noisy tenant pinned to node-gpu-23. queue_len 120 is huge. Could be unbounded concurrent requests from a single tenant. Any per-tenant throttles firing?

tess: checking tenant quotas/ratelimits for LuminaShop... their concurrent limit was 64, but worker reports show bursts ~200 concurrent. Throttles didn't trigger because backend bypassed quota due to dedicated routing bug that skipped the quota-layer for this customer on this cluster (suspected).

raj: if quota-layer was bypassed that's probably cause. Is bypass recent? olivia you said you saw initial surge — any deployments around 10:00?

olivia: There was a config deploy at 09:58 to change routing rules for a different customer, but A/B test flag touched shared routing middleware. Rolling back that change now to restore quota enforcement.

mike: while rollback happens we should reduce immediate impact. Proposed mitigations:
- Add temporary nginx rate-limit for LuminaShop at edge LB (simple request-per-second cap)
- Reroute excess traffic for LuminaShop to backup pool (d-cluster-spare-usw1)
- Drain noisy pods on node-gpu-23 and force placement away from single node

raj: agree. tess, can you flip the routing to spare pool? what's ETA?

tess: can do manual reroute. will update route table now. Command: `redwood route update --customer lumina --to d-cluster-spare-usw1 --weight 1`

deploy-bot: route change initiated by tess — job #8472 queued.

mike: posting a sample failing request from customer logs:

```http
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.luminashop.com
Content-Type: application/json

Response:
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
X-Redwood-Error: backend-timeout
X-Request-Id: rwd_7f89ab
```

raj: good. setting mitigation steps: 1) enforce quota via rollback of middleware (olivia) 2) apply edge rate-limit for LuminaShop for 10m windows (mike) 3) reroute heavy traffic to spare pool (tess) 4) if node still overloaded, evict and reprovision (eunice). Also notify customer with a brief status. maria, can you send quick update to LuminaShop? note "we're mitigating — temporary rate cap and failover in progress"

maria (CS): sending now. message: "We're seeing elevated errors and have applied temporary rate caps and routed traffic to a spare pool. We expect reduced errors within ~10-15 minutes. Will follow up with RCA." :email:

olivia: rollback of A/B routing middleware complete. Quota enforcement back online.

mike: applied nginx rate-limit rule at edge LB for customer-id=lumina: `limit_req zone=lumina burst=50 nodelay;` and reduced max concurrency on the pool with a soft cap.

deploy-bot: route change #8472 succeeded — LuminaShop now sending ~40% traffic to d-cluster-spare-usw1.

mike: after mitigation, metrics trending: 5xx from 18% -> 6% in last 5m. queue_len on node-gpu-23 down to 30. GPU util at 68%. Looks better.

raj: good progress. can we keep measures for 30 minutes and monitor. eunice, do we need to spin additional instances on spare pool?

eunice: autoscaler shows spare pool headroom 30%. I'll start a small scale-up by 2 nodes to handle tail if surge continues. Kicking off scale-up now.

raj: thanks. create an incident ticket and set severity P1 -> P2 if error rate <10% after 15m. Include timeline and action items. olivia can you capture current logs and annotate suspected bug in routing middleware? then assign to eng-runtime for RCA.

olivia: will collect logs and open ticket. suspected root cause: A/B routing flag accidentally toggled a bypass in quota-check path, allowing LuminaShop to exceed concurrency caps and starve a single GPU node.

mike: adding payload sample + traces to ticket. Also found a handful of 504s with `backend-kv-timeout` in headers — KV evictions were observed but not primary cause. posting small snippet:

```log
[10:07:12] WARN inference-worker request_id=rwd_7f89ab backend=kvs error="timeout after 2500ms"
[10:07:13] ERROR runtime request_id=rwd_7f89ac oom=false reason="queue-overflow"
```

raj: thanks. CS update to customer sent. We'll keep mitigations until stabilized. If 5xx sits <8% for next 30m we'll downgrade and start post-incident follow-up.

maria (CS): LuminaShop acknowledges and appreciates rapid response. They accept temporary caps.

olivia: handing off full incident ownership to raj for follow-up/RCAs. I'm on standby if needed.

raj: taking handoff. I'll own the ticket and coordinate with eng-runtime for patch. Thanks team. Closing this slack thread for live mitigation — will post updates in incident ticket. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1047 (LuminaShop elevated 5xx on Dedicated). Severity: P2. Assigned: raj, eng-runtime.
